def factor_volume_price_beta(df):
    """Rolling beta of return on volume change measures volume-price coupling."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_1 = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_1 = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    cov = ret_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).cov(vol_1)
    var = vol_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).var()
    beta = cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    beta = beta.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta"] = beta
    return df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta"]
description: This factor expresses an uncovered orthogonal coupling between price and volume by computing a rolling regression coefficient of daily return on daily volume change. A high positive beta indicates price changes are systematically backed by volume changes (informed flow); a negative beta signals divergence or liquidity-driven moves. It captures the dynamic elasticity of price with respect to flow, distinct from breakout or moving-average patterns.
